enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Bend knees. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Extend legs. Turn to back. Place arm over forehead. Sigh. Remain still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up and getting out of bed
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Stretch arms. Yawn. Sit up. Pick up phone from nightstand. Press button to check time. Put phone down. Swing legs over edge of bed. Place feet on floor. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing face, brushing teeth, and showering
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on light. Turn on faucet. Wash face. Turn off faucet. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn on shower. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Dry body with towel.

Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, and butter. Close refrigerator. Take out frying pan. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on cooker. Crack eggs into pan. Add milk. Stir. Turn off cooker. Transfer eggs to plate. Make toast. Spread butter. Pour milk. Sit and eat. Drink milk. Wash plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open closet. Select shirt. Select pants. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Look in mirror. Comb hair. Apply deodorant. Put on watch. Pick up bag. Check bag contents. Walk to door.

Walk to bus stop. Check phone for bus schedule. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Put on headphones. Listen to music. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital.

Wash hands. Check patient list. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Record notes. Use computer to update records. Consult with doctor. Attend team meeting. Review lab results. Prepare medication. Assist with procedure. Wash hands. Take break. Drink water. Return to work.
Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Sit at table. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Check phone. Finish eating. Return tray. Walk back to work area.

Wash hands. Check patient charts. Enter patient room. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Record notes. Use computer. Consult with colleague. Attend meeting. Review test results. Update patient records. Assist with procedure. Wash hands. Take break. Drink water. Return to work.
Walk to bus stop. Check phone for bus schedule. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Put on headphones. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home.

Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Chop vegetables and meat. Turn on cooker. Place pan. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Turn off cooker. Transfer to plate. Sit and eat. Drink water. Wash plate.

Enter living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch program. Adjust volume. Change channel. Watch another program. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Continue watching. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Turn on monitor. Enter password. Open browser. Check email. Type reply. Open document. Edit document. Save document. Open game. Play game. Close game. Shut down computer. Turn off monitor. Stand up.
Sit on sofa. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Adjust position. Read. Turn page. Close book. Put book down. Stand up. Stretch. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Brushing teeth and washing up for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on faucet. Wet toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off faucet. Wash face. Apply moisturizer. Use toilet. Flush. Wash hands. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.
Enter bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Lie on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Read. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Turn off lamp.
Lie on bed. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Remain still. Breathe. Turn to right side. Sigh. Remain still.
